playlist.playlist_description:
Dallas Willard Ministries is pleased to offer free access to this 6-video series for use in small group studies based on the teaching in Dallas Willard's highly acclaimed book "Hearing God: Developing a Conversational Relationship with God." 

Each 30-minute session incorporates teaching from Dallas along with conversations with Richard Foster and John Ortberg . After a break for discussion in your small group, there is a 10-minute bonus teaching for those who would like to dig a little deeper. We hope you will gather a group of friends to watch this together and discuss the ways you are growing in your conversational relationship with God.

Download the Small Group Leaders' Guide by Gary Moon: https://dwillard.s3.us-west-1.amazonaws.com/Hearing-God-Small-Group-Curriculum-Guide.pdf

See the preview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uucUAQDsnbI&list=UU71cHCubNTVifOiU2RiDd_g&index=3

SERIES CONTENT:
Session 1 - You Were Created for Intimate Friendship with God
      Bonus - Hearing God Is More than Guidance
Session 2 - What Hearing God Is Not
      Bonus - The Stepford Wives
Session 3 - Trinitarian Fellowship: The Word, The Spirit, and Life Together
      Bonus - To Live Is Christ
Session 4 - The Still Small Voice and Its Rivals
      Bonus - How I Hear God
Session 5 - Hearing God in the Context of the Kingdom of God
      Bonus - Listening to God Is More than a Discipline
Session 6 - Hearing God as Life
      Bonus - Conversation, Communion, and Union

LEARN MORE ABOUT THIS TOPIC: Visit our website to learn more about Dallas's book, Hearing God, and other resources that will help you develop a conversational relationship with God: https://dwillard.org/books/hearing-god

#DallasWillard #HearingGod #JohnOrtberg #RichardFoster #SmallGroup #GaryMoon
